  fashion, as opposed to a spontaneous or unstructured application (e.g., the
  frantic pinwheeling of arms one makes to maintain balance after an
  unexpected shove would not be an application of an Athletic • Gymnastic
  skill, but a considered effort to use one’s knowledge of balance and one’s
  own flexibility and agility to successfully walk a narrow ledge would be).

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Acrobatics
@description:
  Descriptions This skill provides a bonus for in-air maneuvers (e.g., flying
  levitation) or swinging on objects. This skill includes the parallel bars,
  uneven bars, and other gymnastic activities in the majority of the activity
  is spent in airborne maneuvers. successful skill roll can reduce the
  severity of a falling critical one (i.e., an 'B' becomes a 'A', a 'D'
  becomes a 'C', etc.).

@@ Athletic Games (Gymnastic)
@stat: Co
@description:
  This skill encompasses any athletic game that primarily volves gymnastic
  skills (e.g., gymnastic events, soccer, ball, etc.). Skill in each game
  must be developed separately, includes rules, techniques, etc.

@@ Climbing
@stat: St
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for climbing maneuvers relatively short
  distances through the use of hand holds, etc. could range from the ability
  to climb sheer faces (absurd) climbing a ladder (easy). The normal climbing
  rate for walls adequate hand holds is 10'/rnd as a “Medium” moving
  maneuver. Poorer handholds or greater speed will increase the difficulty
  the maneuver. Note that extended climbs may require the the Athletic
  Endurance: Scaling Skill.

@@ Contortions
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for manipulating one’s body order to move
  through small openings or absorb sudden crushing impact (other than falls).
  This skill also helps one escape bonds, etc.  Organic
  ........................................................................-10
  Metal Bonds
  ........................................................................-30

@@ Diving
@stat: Ag
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for controlled falling maneuvers. This can
  range from controlling the direction of an extended to diving into water
  safely from a great height (up to 20'/skill if a successful maneuver roll
  is made).

@@ Flying/Gliding
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for flying or gliding through of natural or
  artificial wings (e.g., feathered wings, parachute, hand-glider,
  balloonist, etc.). Flying/gliding has a natural all types of maneuvers
  performed while trying to fly/glide skill is not learned or developed. Does
  not include powered aircraft of any type.

@@ Tumbling
@stat: Ag
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for horizontal dives, rolling, vaulting
  maneuvers, or swinging on stationary objects. Also used to decrease the
  damage one takes from a fall. A character could fall safely up to 2'/skill
  rank if a successful maneuver roll is made.

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -50% | 1.5u | -20 | In your zeal, you have forgotten to fully warm up. You severely pull a major muscle group (GM’s discretion or randomly determined) in the middle of your maneuver, inflicting a “Medium” Muscle wound (with a -30 penalty) and two rounds of stun (from the pain). Yer goin’ down, buddy!
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | 10% | 1.5u | -10 | Poor judgment yields poor control. You slip and fall to the ground, taking damage commensurate with the distance fallen. I hope this was just a surfing roll…
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.25u | +0 | You freeze at the critical moment, failing your maneuver. If appropriate, you may roll on the Maneuver Table with a +20 modification to abort your maneuver in time. Otherwise, you take your chances like the rest of us.
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 10% | 0.3u | +0 | Your equipment breaks suddenly, leaving you dangerously unbalanced (or falling). You may make another skill roll at a modification of -20 to recover from this disaster, otherwise you will not only fail your maneuver…you will take a +20 Fall/ Crush attack (in addition to any other suitable modifiers). Either way, you look foolish.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 20% | 2.0u | +5 | And everything was going so well…you cannot seem to follow through, and it is going to take longer than you thought to get this maneuver back under control…
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 150% | 0.75u | +35 | You skip a light fandango; turn cartwheels ‘cross the floor. You complete your maneuver with the kind of precision and grace that you have always daydreamed about. Onlookers cannot help but watch your moves, as you make the impossible look easy.
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 0.8u | +10 | You are seeming inches from your goal…if appropriate, you may roll again next round at a +10 modification to complete your maneuver.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Fancy footwork, my friend! You complete your maneuver in fine form.
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 0.8u | +30 | You barely broke a sweat. Must be the shoes.
